title: Pay online, working locally: customer email in the local outbox (test mode), a test gateway for agency payment links, deposit and balance links, Stripe local methods such as iDEAL, and invoice creation as a domain function
goal: On a local stack an agency can create a deposit link on an invoice, open the payment page, pay with a method suited to the currency, and see the payment recorded; customer emails land in the local outbox instead of SendGrid. Production paths are unchanged.
why: Gap 3 and brief item 12 (TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 8 and 13.4). There is no test gateway for agency links (only the subscription mock), so the payment page cannot be shown; links are always for the full balance; iDEAL availability was never checked; and sendMail sends every agency email through SendGrid even in TEST_MODE (checked 2026-10-21), so a customer email cannot be opened locally.

items.what: Customer email in the local outbox
steps: provider.ts sendMail: for kinds agency_transactional and agency_marketing, when isTestMode(env), write an entry to the KV outbox (OUTBOX_PREFIX from transactional.ts, same TTL) with {kind, tenantId (when the message carries it; add an optional tenantId to OutgoingEmail and pass it from the email queue), to, subject, html, text, attachmentNames, createdAt} and return {success: true, provider: 'outbox'} without calling SendGrid.
GET /test/outbox gains ?tenantId= and ?kind=agency|system filters (system mail unchanged).
Production and non-test environments: unchanged; a test proves SendGrid fetch is still called with TEST_MODE off.

items.what: Invoice creation as a domain function
steps: Move the body of the create-invoice route (numbering, tax engine call, items, totals, activity, events) into services/domain/invoices.ts createInvoice(env, tenantId, db, input, actor); the route calls it and answers exactly as before (existing invoice tests are the guard). R148, R150 and R152 build on it.
AgencyGatewayId gains 'mock', accepted only when mockAllowed(env) (import from services/billing/gateway.ts; do not edit billing files).
integrations.ts: GET payment gateways reports mockAvailable; connecting 'mock' stores a payment_gateway_accounts row with no secrets; in production 'mock' is refused (400).

mock-agency.ts: createPaymentLink for mock stores {tenantId, invoiceId, amount, currency, linkRef, purpose} in KV mockpay:<linkRef> (7 days) and returns `${API_PUBLIC_URL || request origin}/api/v1/webhooks/payments/mock-pay/<tenantKey>/<linkRef>` (build from the API's own base URL, like R135-7).

payment-webhooks.ts: GET /mock-pay/:tenantKey/:linkRef serves a small HTML page (agency name from settings, amount in the agency locale, methods by currency: EUR iDEAL / card / Bancontact, GBP card / Pay by bank, INR UPI / card, else card; Pay, Fail, Cancel); POST /mock-pay/:tenantKey/:linkRef signs a mock event with mockSecret and runs it through the same handler as POST /:tenantKey/mock (verify, claim event id, recordInvoicePayment once, emit payment.recorded); then redirects to ?return= when it starts with APP_URL, else shows 'Payment received'. Both answer 404 when mock is not allowed.
The mock pay page text uses the backend i18n catalogue (en, nl) from R136.
0058: invoices ADD payment_link_amount REAL, payment_link_purpose TEXT; schema and bundle.

POST /invoices/:id/payment-link accepts {gateway?, amount?, purpose?: deposit|balance|custom}; deposit = payment_defaults.deposit (percent of total or fixed) unless an amount is given; amount must be > 0 and <= balance_due (400 otherwise); stored with the link. A paid deposit leaves the invoice partially_paid; one live link per invoice stays the rule.

settings.ts: payment_defaults key (design 4.3) with GET/PUT under /settings/payment-defaults; Invoice defaults page gains a Payments card (deposit type and value; Stripe methods; bank reference format).

Invoice page 'Pay online' card: Create link opens payment-link-dialog (Deposit, Balance, Custom amount), shows the link with Copy and 'Send to customer' through SendMessageDialog (never mailto or wa.me).
Keep dynamic payment methods by default (no payment_method_types sent) and assert it in a test.
When payment_defaults.stripeMethodTypes is set, send payment_method_types[i]; validate per currency (ideal and bancontact only for EUR; sepa_debit EUR); a mismatch is a readable 400.
Integrations Stripe card hint: 'Customers see the methods enabled in your Stripe dashboard. For euro invoices, enable iDEAL there.' (t()).

tests: backend/test/agency-mail-outbox.test.ts: in TEST_MODE a hub email (communications send email, and the email queue) is written to the outbox with the tenant id and no fetch to SendGrid; with TEST_MODE off and a key, the mocked fetch is called; GET /test/outbox?tenantId= filters.

backend/test/agency-mock-gateway.test.ts: connect mock; deposit link 30% on a EUR invoice; GET mock-pay page lists iDEAL for EUR and UPI for INR; POST pay records exactly one payment of the link amount and the invoice becomes partially_paid; a replay does nothing; ENVIRONMENT=production -> 404 and connect refused; return URL outside APP_URL is ignored.
backend/test/payment-links.test.ts: amount above balance 400; Stripe body has no payment_method_types by default and the explicit list for EUR; ideal on GBP 400.
Existing invoice tests unchanged and green after the createInvoice extraction.
desktop vitest: payment-link-dialog amounts (deposit percent, fixed, custom bounds).

e2e/pay-online.spec.ts: connect the test gateway in Settings > Integrations, create a deposit link on an invoice, open it, pay with iDEAL, return, see the payment and the balance; read the customer email of a sent invoice from GET /test/outbox?tenantId=.
acceptance: The payment page opens and completes on a local stack; the payment appears once.
Customer emails in test mode are readable in the outbox; nothing reaches SendGrid in test mode.
Production behaviour (real gateways, SendGrid) is unchanged.

cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/pay-online.spec.ts e2e/invoices.spec.ts e2e/payments.spec.ts e2e/webhooks-integrations.spec.ts e2e/communication-inbox.spec.ts e2e/settings-team.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Test-only paths are fenced by isTestMode / mockAllowed and are unreachable in production (tests prove it).
Payment links reach customers only through the Communication Hub (SendMessageDialog).
Backend: tenant migration 0058 only; regenerate the bundle; UUIDv7 ids; money through utils/money.ts.
Desktop: CONTRACT.md; t() with en and nl keys in messages/<lang>/payments.json only; RTL-safe classes; money through lib/format.ts.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 8 and 13.4, the R207 batch file, backend/src/services/billing/mock.ts and routes/billing.ts (mock checkout pattern, do not edit), services/mail/transactional.ts.
R143 runs in parallel and owns services/departures and the automation files; do not edit them.
Check that no existing e2e relied on agency emails failing in test mode; if one did, it was asserting a bug: report it.
goLiveVerify: An EUR payment link from a Stripe test account with iDEAL enabled shows iDEAL; a Razorpay INR link still works.
